title: Handle Exterior Caps Behind Nodes
description: Flow and puzzle 2d handles should always render behind nodes and only show the portion outside the node shape (e.g. half-circle caps on circular nodes).
summary: Handles now render behind nodes as exterior semicircle caps (only the portion outside the node body). Shared geometry helpers build outward-facing fill/stroke paths. BoardHost paints handles before nodes and clips rim handles to exterior caps; indirect ring handles stay full circles. DAG flow paint paints handles before node bodies with the same caps. Updated puzzle 2d host tests for overlay fill path-tag behavior.
